episodes.name: Crimes of the Hot
episodes.overview: When Earth is jeopardized by global warming, the crew attends a conference in Kyoto hosted by Al Gore's head.

episodes.name: Jurassic Bark
episodes.overview: Bender grows jealous when Fry attempts to clone Seymour, his beloved fossilized dog.

episodes.name: The Route of All Evil
episodes.overview: Farnsworth's clone Cubert teams up with Hermes' son Dwight to launch a newspaper delivery business. Farnsworth and Hermes scoff at the kids' efforts - until the delivery boys accumulate enough capital to buy out Planet Express. Meanwhile, Fry and Leela use Bender to brew their own homemade beer.

episodes.name: A Taste of Freedom
episodes.overview: Zoidberg becomes the center of a Supreme Court case after he celebrates Freedom Day by publicly eating the Earth flag.

episodes.name: Kif Gets Knocked Up a Notch
episodes.overview: When Kif gets pregnant, Amy questions her readiness to become a parent.

episodes.name: Less Than Hero
episodes.overview: When Fry and Leela discover a cream that gives them unusual powers, they form a superhero team along with Bender.

episodes.name: Teenage Mutant Leela's Hurdles
episodes.overview: The Planet Express crew is exposed to a substance that causes everyone to age backwards.

episodes.name: The Why of Fry
episodes.overview: Nibbler enlists Fry in a mission to blow up evil brains bent on destroying the universe.

episodes.name: The Sting
episodes.overview: The Planet Express crew attempt the mission that killed the last crew: raiding a massive alien beehive for its honey.

episodes.name: The Farnsworth Parabox
episodes.overview: The Planet Express crew goes to a parallel universe made accessible by the Professor's latest experiment.

episodes.name: Three Hundred Big Boys
episodes.overview: With the help of a $300 government refund, the Planet Express crew pursue their dreams and desires.

episodes.name: Spanish Fry
episodes.overview: Fry's nose is stolen by alien poachers to sell as a black market aphrodesiac.

episodes.name: Bend Her
episodes.overview: Bender's scam to win Olympic gold sets him on the road to becoming a celebrity wife.

episodes.name: Obsoletely Fabulous
episodes.overview: A new model of robot threatens Bender, forcing him to run away after he avoids upgrading his own technology.

episodes.name: Bender Should Not Be Allowed on TV
episodes.overview: Bender becomes a television star as well as a terrible role model for children.

episodes.name: The Devil's Hands Are Idle Playthings
episodes.overview: Fry makes a deal with the Robot Devil so he can become a skillful musician and win Leela's heart.
